inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 1 child's file did have a health statement at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: 4 of the 10 caregiver files did not have a total of 24 trainings hours at the time of inspection from hire date to anniversary date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: 2 of the infant cribs with infants inside of them were not labled at the time of my walk through and inpection. This was corrected by having the caregivers label the cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Operation has not practiced or documented fire drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: A caregiver failed to use a positive method of discipline and guidance with a child in care by throwing a ball at a child's back.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, the operation was found deficient with this standard as a caregiver exercised poor judgment in the manner in which she physically handled/repositioned an infant in care to a sitting position.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, the operation was found non-compliant with this standard, as a caregiver allowed an infant to sleep in a restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: 4 children enrolled still did not have health statements on file for review at the time of follow up inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: 4 children enrolled did not have health statements on file for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: At the time of inspection, the operational policies did not have a policy on: Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: At the time of inspection, the operational policies did not have a policy on: Preventing and responding to abuse and neglect of children
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases: At the time of inspection, the operational policies did not have a policy on:Information on vaccine-preventable diseases for employee
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases (26 TAC §746.501(a)(28))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Duration: At the time of inspection, the operational policies did not have a policy on: The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor;
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Duration (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(B))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the information provided during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver aggressively pulled a child by the arm and dropped the child on the nap cot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to comply with this standard by not completing an incident report for a child's incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to comply with this standard because a caregiver inappropriately picked up an infant by 1 arm and brought the infant to the mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to comply with this standard by not completing an incident report for a child's ant bite incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to comply with this standard by not notifying the parent of the ant bite incident that took place at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that the operation was deficient in this standard as a caregiver was observed pinching a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation, a violation was found. The operation failed to relay all pertinent information to the parent to be able to make an informed medical decision regarding the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information provided during the investigation, the operation was found deficient in this standard for allowing children to play football indoors resulting in a child losing their 2 front teeth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Regular Meals and Snacks: The operation was requiring parents to provide a doctors note prior to serving the table food eating infants, table food.If there was no doctors note provided the child would not be served what was on the menu.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Regular Meals and Snacks (26 TAC §746.3301(a))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained during the investigation the operation was found non-compliant with this standard as no incident report was completed for the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information obtained during the investigation the operation was found non-compliant with this standard as a 3-year-old child was left outside on the playground alone for approximately 16 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on the information obtained during the investigation the operation was found non-compliant with this standard as no incident report was shared with the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained during the investigation the operation was found non-compliant with this standard as no report was made to childcare regulation of the incident by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information received during the investigation inspection, the operation was found non-compliant in this standard. The caregiver did not use good judgment when purchasing and administering nighttime teething tablets to an infant without parental authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Special Diets - No Nutrient Concentrates or Supplements: Based on the information received during the investigation inspection, the operation was found non-compliant in this standard. The caregiver administered nighttime teething tablets without parental or health care professional authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Special Diets - No Nutrient Concentrates or Supplements (26 TAC §746.3311(d))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the information obtained during the investigation it was determined that a caregiver used prohibited punishment on a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During investigation 3027975 it was found that the operations bus driver did not have a background check submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the investigation it was determined that the operation failed to use good judgement when an emergency situation arose on the operations bus.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Over 5 infants were not buckled in their high chairs for meal time. This was corrected at inspection by having the caregiver buckle all the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: There was one caregiver present in the classroom with children that did not have a background check submitted with new operation number. This was corrected at inspection by having the caregiver leave the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning supplies (disinfectant and fabuloso) were left out accessible to children in room 550. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: 1 child diagnosed with food allergies that has an epi pen did not have a completed allergy plan on file signed by a healthcare professional. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
